title: Giraffe holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='72' rx='24' ry='15' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='68' r='4' fill='#a8642a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='76' r='5' fill='#a8642a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='67' r='3.5' fill='#a8642a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='80' r='3' fill='#a8642a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <rect x='38' y='83' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#e0a63a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='83' width='7' height='13' rx='3' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <rect x='64' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0a63a'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='26' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <rect x='38' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <rect x='54' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <rect x='64' y='93' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M60 66 Q70 40 68 22 L78 22 Q80 44 70 70 Z' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='56' r='3.5' fill='#a8642a'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='44' r='3' fill='#a8642a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#a8642a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='18' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='8' r='3' fill='#e0a63a'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='8' r='3' fill='#e0a63a'/>
  <rect x='69' y='9' width='3' height='5' fill='#c98a32'/>
  <rect x='77' y='9' width='3' height='5' fill='#c98a32'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='21' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#e0a63a'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='16' r='2.2' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='79.7' cy='15.3' r='0.8' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='15' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e0a63a'/>
  <!-- front leg holding heart -->
  <path d='M62 62 Q64 58 60 56' stroke='#f4b942' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M46 44 C46 38 54 36 54 42 C54 36 62 38 62 44 C62 52 54 58 54 58 C54 58 46 52 46 44 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M49 42 C49 39 52 39 52 42' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- second front hoof near heart -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#f4b942'/>
</svg>
